'''Aranei''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that was owned by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she was killed at the [[Nightsister Stronghold]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was trying to obtain the [[Shard of Obedience]].<ref name="SWG:TNH" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aranei appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aranei was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
